Mechanical valves require a vitamin K antagonist. DOACs are contraindicated — they were inferior in trial and carry excess thrombosis and bleeding in this setting.

💡

Pulmonary hypertension is now mean PAP >20 mmHg at rest.

Calling it arterial additionally requires

PVR >2 Wood units and a wedge pressure ≤15 mmHg.

#MRCP #Pearl

💡

Topic: Cardiology, Pulmonary embolism

💎 The Pearl

Apixaban or rivaroxaban are first-line for confirmed PE and DVT — no lead-in heparin needed, unlike dabigatran and edoxaban which require 5 days of LMWH first.

#MRCP #Pearl

💡

Topic: Cardiology, Ventricular tachycardia

💎 The Pearl

Broad-complex tachycardia — features that mean ventricular, not aberrancy:

  • AV dissociation (independent P waves; cannon a waves)
  • Capture and fusion beats
  • Positive or negative concordance across the chest leads
  • QRS >160 ms, extreme axis

Structural heart disease or previous MI makes VT overwhelmingly likely — treat broad-complex tachycardia as VT until proven otherwise.

#MRCP #Pearl

💡

Topic: Cardiology, ACE inhibitors

💎 The Pearl

Core rule — ACE inhibitor cough (and angioedema) is bradykinin‑mediated.

Do — Stop the ACE inhibitor; switch to an ARB if RAAS blockade is still needed.

Avoid / trap — Don’t mis-treat it as allergy/asthma; it’s not histamine‑mediated.

Memory hook — “ACE breaks down bradykinin; block ACE → bradykinin builds up.”

#MRCP #Pearl

💡

Topic: Cardiology, Adrenaline

💎 The Pearl

Adrenaline timing in cardiac arrest depends on the rhythm:

- Non-shockable — give 1 mg (10 mL of 1:10,000) IV as soon as possible.

- Shockable — hold until after the 3rd shock.

- Repeat every 3–5 minutes in both cases.

#MRCP #Pearl

💡

Topic: Cardiology, Adenosine diphosphate (ADP) receptor inhibitors

💎 The Pearl

Three P2Y12 inhibitors, three distinguishing features:

- Clopidogrel — a prodrug needing CYP2C19 activation; loss-of-function variants blunt its effect.

- Ticagrelor — reversible binding, not a prodrug; causes dyspnoea and bradycardia.

- Prasugrel — contraindicated after stroke/TIA; caution from age 75 due to bleeding risk.

#MRCP #Pearl

Topic: Cardiology, Adult advanced life support

💎 The Pearl

- In refractory VF/pulseless VT, give amiodarone 300 mg after the third shock, with a further 150 mg after the fifth shock.

- Lidocaine 100 mg is the alternative if amiodarone is unavailable.

#MRCP #Pearl

💡

Topic: Cardiology, Amiodarone toxicity

💎 The Pearl

Amiodarone toxicity — organ by organ:

- Thyroid: both hypo- and hyperthyroidism (it's an iodine-rich molecule)

- Lung: pneumonitis progressing to fibrosis

- Liver: transaminitis, occasionally hepatitis

- Eye: corneal microdeposits (usually benign), optic neuropathy

- Skin: photosensitivity, slate-grey discolouration

Its half-life runs to weeks, so effects and interactions persist long after stopping.

#MRCP #Pearl
